frames.narration: One service talks to two dependencies. Instead of one shared pool of 10 workers, it has two compartments of 5, one per dependency.
Normal operation: payment requests use the payments pool, and search requests use the search pool.
The payment API becomes very slow. Each payment call now holds a worker for seconds.
More payment requests arrive and every payments worker is stuck waiting. The compartment is full.
New payment requests are rejected immediately with a clear error. They cannot take workers from anywhere else.
Search is unaffected. Its pool is separate, so search requests keep getting workers and fast answers.
With one shared pool, the same slow payments would have taken all 10 workers and search would have died too. The failure stayed in its compartment.
